prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: unit-a-painted, a single original dark-fantasy mercenary game unit sprite, not a collage or sheet.
Primary request: One weary sellsword, full body, facing screen-right, in a padded gambeson, holding a sword and a round shield. This is variant A, the painted visual baseline for a five-asset style study.
Subject: A lean, weather-worn adult sellsword with short dark hair streaked grey, stubble, a tired face; charcoal-brown quilted padded gambeson with worn stitched seams, a plain leather belt, dull iron sword in his right hand pointed down and forward, and a scuffed plain round wooden shield with an iron boss on his left forearm. Mud-worn boots. No heraldry. The subject and all equipment must remain complete and readable.
Style/medium: Hand-painted 2D sprite with economical brushwork, matte textures, thin dark contour outline, strong readable silhouette. Dark muted palette: charcoal, weathered brown, dull steel, desaturated taupe; restrained warm skin. Not photorealistic, not 3D.
Composition/framing: Square composition intended for a 512x512 final PNG. Single centered figure fills about 80 percent of image height, generous empty padding on every side. Sprite-based 2.5D three-quarter top-down orthographic camera pitched downward about 30 degrees; see top of shoulders and shield, with foreshortened feet. Torso, head and stance face right; no front-facing portrait. Both boots visible and separated. No pedestal, floor or scenery.
Lighting/mood: Soft upper-left light painted into the figure, grim restrained mood, no cast or contact shadows outside the sprite.
Scene/backdrop: Perfectly flat uniform solid #00ff00 chroma-key green background for subsequent local removal to transparent alpha. No gradients, texture, lighting variation, reflections, shadows or checkerboard on the background. Never use chroma green in the figure.
Constraints: Entirely original design. Do not imitate Battle Brothers, Heroes of Might and Magic, any existing game, franchise or artist. No text, lettering, logos, symbols or watermarks. Exactly one unit and no layout labels. Produce this one image only.
model: image_gen (built-in; underlying model identifier not exposed)
